shots.beat: Rain City at night: a slow crane down through the rain onto Kai walking the wet centre line toward Helix.

setup.eval: (()=>{let n=0; __game.scene.traverse(o=>{const m=o.material, p=o.geometry&&o.geometry.parameters; if(o.isMesh&&m&&m.emissiveMap&&p&&p.height===3.2){m.emissiveIntensity=0.45; n++;}}); return n})()

shots.characters: Kai (walking away from camera), umbrella crowd on both pavements
shots.lighting: Neon blade signs, puddle glow, rain streaks lit by the lamps; Helix tower rings at the vanishing point.
shots.sound: Rain bed, distant traffic hum, footsteps; piano motif enters at the cut.

shots.beat: The toy that un-falls: a child drops a toy, it lands, then rises back into her hand along the same arc.

shots.characters: The station child (yellow coat, red boots), her mother under a red umbrella
shots.lighting: Low, child eye-level, in profile along the pavement: lamps and umbrellas recede behind her; the toy's cyan eye and its reverse trail.
shots.notes: The toy loop runs on game time (4 s): the setup waits for cycle 3.5 so the cut holds hand, fall, floor, un-fall, hand. VO "Mister, your wrist is glowing." lands on the un-fall.

shots.beat: Kai's wrist: the Chronolith band glows, then flares as the street pulls toward one moment.

shots.notes: Rook walks out of the lobby when control returns (4 s); the setup waits for that, brings him back and holds the drones off (control=false).
